components.position_source: 4 brackets; brake side inboard on both wheels (local +y points away from the wheel: inner brackets face inboard, outer brackets outboard)
components.provisional_label: Design intent, not CAD: owner fridayali

components.name: Second E-stop housing on the adapter plate behind the post, button up (design intent)
components.purpose: Second E-stop housing on the adapter plate behind the post, button up (design intent). Method: laser-cut and bent 5754 aluminium sheet, 2.0 mm. Adjustment: fore-aft on the plate between the column axis and the rear upright (slotted flange holes, +/-10 mm).
components.position_source: one position (A5): adapter plate top behind the post, centred in y, above the column, button up; moves with the lift (xyz at bp000 and L1000, on the adapter plate top; moves with the lift (+0.175 / +0.350); pitch -pi/2: button up)
components.provisional_label: Design intent, not CAD: owner fridayali

components.name: Getac ZX80 pocket, portrait (decided default), back plate and light-bar plate (design intent)
components.purpose: Getac ZX80 pocket, portrait (decided default), back plate and light-bar plate (design intent). Method: laser-cut 5754 aluminium plates, machined 6082-T6 spacer hub, PETG pocket, 3.0 mm. Adjustment: none (fixed portrait mount); the tablet lifts out of the pocket.
components.position_source: L1000, portrait on a fixed mount (A3) (arm-post front face x 0.060 + 0.180 + 0.060 = 0.300 (bp000); tablet centre 0.246 above the column top at L1000 (datums.yaml getac_tablet_z_above_column_top), 0.)
components.provisional_label: Design intent, not CAD: owner fridayali
